import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    c = np.cos(params[8]*np.sqrt(t))
    s = np.sin(params[8]*np.sqrt(t))
    return params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*x**3 + params[3]*v + params[4]/v + params[5]*np.log(x) + params[6]*c + params[7]*s + params[9]*(c+s)/v
